  const run = (action: () => void) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    action();

  if (key === ' ') {

    if (key === 'z') run(event.shiftKey ? editor.redo : editor.undo);
    else if (key === 'y') run(editor.redo);
    else if (key === 'd') run(editor.duplicate);
    else if (key === 'a') run(editor.selectAll);
    else if (key === '=' || key === '+') run(() => editor.zoomBy(1.25));
    else if (key === '-') run(() => editor.zoomBy(1 / 1.25));
    else if (key === '0') run(() => editor.zoomBy(1 / editor.view.zoom));

    const entries = new Map<string, { layer: Layer; parent: Layer | null }>();
    for (const layer of layers.value) {
      entries.set(layer.id, { layer, parent: null });
      for (const child of layer.children ?? []) entries.set(child.id, { layer: child, parent: layer });
    }
    return entries;
  });

  const find = (id: Key) => index.value.get(String(id))?.layer;
  const parentOf = (id: Key) => index.value.get(String(id))?.parent ?? null;
  /** The layers of `frame`, or of the canvas: front first. */
  const childrenOf = (frame: Layer | null) => (frame ? (frame.children ??= []) : layers.value);

  /** Where a layer is on the canvas, in world units: its frame's corner plus its own position. */
  const boxOf = (layer: Layer): Box => {
    const parent = parentOf(layer.id);
    return { x: layer.x + (parent?.x ?? 0), y: layer.y + (parent?.y ?? 0), width: layer.width, height: layer.height };
  };

  /** The layers of `ids` whose frame isn't one of them: a frame brings its layers along. */
  const topLevel = (ids: Iterable<Key>) => {
    const wanted = new Set([...ids].map(String));
    return [...index.value.values()]
      .filter(({ layer, parent }) => wanted.has(layer.id) && !(parent && wanted.has(parent.id)))
      .map(({ layer }) => layer);
  };

  const visible = computed(() => [...index.value.values()].filter(({ layer, parent }) => !layer.hidden && !parent?.hidden));

  /** The box around the layers of `ids`; `null` when none is a layer (a tool from the toolbar). */
  const boundsOf = (ids: Key[]) => union(topLevel(ids).map(boxOf));

  /** What the dragged layers line up with: every other visible layer, frames included. */
  const snapTargets = (ids: Key[]) => {
    const moving = new Set(ids.map(String));
    return visible.value
      .filter(({ layer, parent }) => !moving.has(layer.id) && !(parent && moving.has(parent.id)))
      .map(({ layer }) => boxOf(layer));
  };

  // ─── Selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const selected = computed(() => topLevel(selection.ids));

  /**
   * A click picks one layer; with Shift it is added or taken out. A frame and a layer in it
   * are never selected together: dragged, the layer would move twice.
   */
  const select = (id: string, additive = false) => {
    if (!additive) return selection.set([id]);
    if (selection.has(id)) return selection.delete(id);
    const related = [parentOf(id), ...(find(id)?.children ?? [])].flatMap((layer) => (layer ? [layer.id] : []));
    selection.delete(...related);
    selection.add(id);
  };

  const selectAll = () => selection.set(layers.value.filter((layer) => !layer.hidden).map((layer) => layer.id));

  // ─── History ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The design before each change, as JSON, and the changes undone. */
  const past = shallowRef<string[]>([]);
  const future = shallowRef<string[]>([]);
  let lastKey: string | null = null;

  /**
   * Saves the design before a change: one undo step. Changes with the same `key` in a row
   * (one field typed into, one handle dragged) make a single step.
   */
  const record = (key: string | null = null) => {
    if (key !== null && key === lastKey) return;
    lastKey = key;
    past.value = [...past.value.slice(1 - HISTORY), JSON.stringify(layers.value)];
    future.value = [];
  };

  const restore = (snapshot: string) => {
    layers.value = JSON.parse(snapshot);
    lastKey = null;
    // Layers that the restored design doesn't have can't stay selected.
    selection.set([...selection.ids].filter((id) => index.value.has(String(id))));
  };

  const undo = () => {
    const snapshot = past.value.at(-1);
    if (snapshot === undefined) return;
    future.value = [...future.value, JSON.stringify(layers.value)];
    past.value = past.value.slice(0, -1);
    restore(snapshot);
  };

  const redo = () => {
    const snapshot = future.value.at(-1);
    if (snapshot === undefined) return;
    past.value = [...past.value, JSON.stringify(layers.value)];
    future.value = future.value.slice(0, -1);
    restore(snapshot);
  };

  // ─── Changes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const detach = (layer: Layer) => {
    const siblings = childrenOf(parentOf(layer.id));
    siblings.splice(siblings.indexOf(layer), 1);
  };

  /**
   * Moves layers by `shift` (world units) into `frame`, or onto the canvas (`null`). A layer
   * that changes frames goes on top of the layers there; frames stay on the canvas. `copy`
   * leaves the layers where they are and puts copies there instead, selected.
   */
  const move = (ids: Key[], shift: Point, frame: Layer | null, copy = false) => {
    record();
    const arrivals = new Map<Layer | null, Layer[]>();
    for (const layer of topLevel(ids)) {
      const box = boxOf(layer);
      const into = layer.kind === 'frame' ? null : frame;
      const moved = copy ? copyLayer(layer) : layer;
      moved.x = Math.round(box.x + shift.x - (into?.x ?? 0));
      moved.y = Math.round(box.y + shift.y - (into?.y ?? 0));
      if (!copy && parentOf(layer.id) === into) continue;
      if (!copy) detach(layer);
      arrivals.set(into, [...(arrivals.get(into) ?? []), moved]);
    }
    for (const [into, arrived] of arrivals) childrenOf(into).unshift(...arrived);
    if (copy) selection.set([...arrivals.values()].flat().map((layer) => layer.id));
  };

  /** Adds a layer of `kind` centred on `center` (world units), in `frame` or on the canvas. */
  const add = (kind: LayerKind, center: Point, frame: Layer | null = null) => {
    record();
    const into = kind === 'frame' ? null : frame;
    const { name, width, height } = KINDS[kind];
    const count = [...index.value.values()].filter(({ layer }) => layer.kind === kind).length + 1;
    const x = Math.round(center.x - width / 2 - (into?.x ?? 0));
    const y = Math.round(center.y - height / 2 - (into?.y ?? 0));
    const layer = createLayer(kind, `${name} ${count}`, x, y);
    childrenOf(into).unshift(layer);
    selection.set([layer.id]);
  };

  const remove = () => {
    const doomed = selected.value;
    if (!doomed.length) return;
    record();
    doomed.forEach(detach);
    selection.clear();
  };

  /** Copies of the selected layers, a little down and to the right, just in front of them. */
  const duplicate = () => {
    const sources = selected.value;
    if (!sources.length) return;
    record();
    const copies = sources.map((source) => {
      const copy = { ...copyLayer(source), x: source.x + 16, y: source.y + 16 };
      const siblings = childrenOf(parentOf(source.id));
      siblings.splice(siblings.indexOf(source), 0, copy);
      return copy;
    });
    selection.set(copies.map((copy) => copy.id));
  };

  /** Moves the selection with the arrow keys; pressing them in a row is one undo step. */
  const nudge = (x: number, y: number) => {
    if (!selected.value.length) return;
    record(`nudge:${[...selection.ids].join()}`);
    for (const layer of selected.value) {
      layer.x += x;
      layer.y += y;
    }
  };

  /** Edits of a layer: edits of one field in a row are one undo step, as are those with the same `key`. */
  const update = (layer: Layer, patch: Partial<Layer>, key = `${Object.keys(patch).join()}:${layer.id}`) => {
    record(key);
    Object.assign(layer, patch);
  };

  const rename = (layer: Layer, name: string) => {
    record();
    layer.name = name;
  };

  const setHidden = (layer: Layer, hidden: boolean) => {
    record();
    layer.hidden = hidden;
    // A hidden layer isn't on the canvas: nothing to select or drag.
    if (hidden) selection.delete(layer.id, ...(layer.children ?? []).map((child) => child.id));
  };

  /** Several layers line up with each other; one layer lines up with its frame. */
  const align = (alignment: Alignment) => {
    const targets = selected.value;
    const frame = targets.length === 1 ? parentOf(targets[0]!.id) : null;
    const bounds = frame ? boxOf(frame) : targets.length > 1 ? union(targets.map(boxOf)) : null;
    if (!bounds) return;
    record();
    for (const layer of targets) {
      const box = boxOf(layer);
      const to = aligned(box, bounds, alignment);
      layer.x += Math.round(to.x - box.x);
      layer.y += Math.round(to.y - box.y);
    }
  };

  /** Equal space between three or more layers, the outer ones staying where they are. */
  const distribute = (axis: Axis) => {
    const targets = selected.value;
    if (targets.length < 3) return;
    record();
    const boxes = targets.map(boxOf);
    distributed(boxes, axis).forEach((start, index) => (targets[index]![axis] += Math.round(start - boxes[index]![axis])));
  };

  // ─── View ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** Pan and zoom: a point of the world is drawn at `x + point × zoom` in the canvas. */
  const view = reactive({ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 });
  const viewport = { width: 0, height: 0 };
  /** Until the view is panned or zoomed, the design is fitted again when the canvas resizes. */
  let fitted = true;

  const fit = () => {
    const bounds = union(visible.value.filter(({ parent }) => !parent).map(({ layer }) => boxOf(layer)));
    if (!bounds || !viewport.width) return;
    const padding = Math.min(FIT_PADDING, viewport.width * 0.08);
    const room = { width: viewport.width - 2 * padding, height: viewport.height - 2 * padding };
    const zoom = Math.max(ZOOM.min, Math.min(room.width / bounds.width, room.height / bounds.height, ZOOM.fit));
    view.zoom = zoom;
    view.x = Math.round((viewport.width - bounds.width * zoom) / 2 - bounds.x * zoom);
    view.y = Math.round((viewport.height - bounds.height * zoom) / 2 - bounds.y * zoom);
    fitted = true;
  };

  const setViewport = (width: number, height: number) => {
    Object.assign(viewport, { width, height });
    if (fitted) fit();
  };

  const panBy = (x: number, y: number) => {
    view.x += x;
    view.y += y;
    fitted = false;
  };

  /** Zooms by `factor` around a point of the canvas (its centre by default), which stays put. */
  const zoomBy = (factor: number, around: Point = { x: viewport.width / 2, y: viewport.height / 2 }) => {
    const zoom = Math.min(ZOOM.max, Math.max(ZOOM.min, view.zoom * factor));
    view.x = around.x - ((around.x - view.x) * zoom) / view.zoom;
    view.y = around.y - ((around.y - view.y) * zoom) / view.zoom;
    view.zoom = zoom;
    fitted = false;
  };

  /** What a dragged layer carries: itself, and where it is drawn in the world, in screen pixels. */
  const dragData = (layer: Layer): DragData => {
    const box = boxOf(layer);
    return { layer, left: box.x * view.zoom, top: box.y * view.zoom };
  };

  /** The centre of the canvas, in world units: where a clicked tool adds its layer. */
  const center = (): Point => ({
    x: (viewport.width / 2 - view.x) / view.zoom,
    y: (viewport.height / 2 - view.y) / view.zoom,
  });

  // ─── Tools and transient state ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  const tool = ref<Tool>('move');
  /** Space held: the hand tool for as long as it is. */
  const spaceHeld = ref(false);
  const panning = computed(() => tool.value === 'hand' || spaceHeld.value);
  /** Alt held while a drag drops: copies land, the layers stay. */
  const altHeld = useKeyModifier('Alt', { initial: false });
  /** Shift held when a band starts: it adds to the selection. */
  const shiftHeld = useKeyModifier('Shift', { initial: false });
  const hovered = ref<string | null>(null);
  const guides = shallowRef<Guides>(NO_GUIDES);

  return {
    layers,
    find,
    parentOf,
    boxOf,
    dragData,
    boundsOf,
    snapTargets,
    selected,
    select,
    selectAll,
    record,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo: computed(() => past.value.length > 0),
    canRedo: computed(() => future.value.length > 0),
    move,
    add,
    remove,
    duplicate,
    nudge,
    update,
    rename,
    setHidden,
    align,
    distribute,
    view,
    fit,
    setViewport,
    panBy,
    zoomBy,
    center,
    tool,
    spaceHeld,
    panning,
    altHeld,
    shiftHeld,
    hovered,
    guides,
  };
}

/** Boxes and lines on the canvas, in world units (100% zoom): snapping, guides, alignment. */

export interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export interface Box extends Point {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export type Axis = 'x' | 'y';

/** A pink line at `at` on `axis` (a vertical line for 'x'), drawn from `from` to `to` along the other axis. */
export interface Guide {
  axis: Axis;
  at: number;
  from: number;
  to: number;
}

export interface Guides {
  lines: Guide[];
  /** The space between the moved box and the closest box it lines up with, labelled with its length. */
  gaps: Guide[];
}

export const NO_GUIDES: Guides = { lines: [], gaps: [] };

const SIZE = { x: 'width', y: 'height' } as const;
const ACROSS = { x: 'y', y: 'x' } as const;

/** The lines a box snaps by along an axis: its start, its centre and its end. */
const linesOf = (box: Box, axis: Axis) => {
  const start = box[axis];
  const size = box[SIZE[axis]];
  return [start, start + size / 2, start + size];
};

export const offsetBox = (box: Box, x: number, y: number): Box => ({ ...box, x: box.x + x, y: box.y + y });

/** The smallest box around all of them; `null` for none. */
export const union = (boxes: Box[]): Box | null => {
  if (!boxes.length) return null;
  const left = Math.min(...boxes.map((box) => box.x));
  const top = Math.min(...boxes.map((box) => box.y));
  const right = Math.max(...boxes.map((box) => box.x + box.width));
  const bottom = Math.max(...boxes.map((box) => box.y + box.height));
  return { x: left, y: top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
};

/**
 * How far `values` (positions on `axis`) must move so that one of them sits on a line of
 * `targets`, if one is within `reach`: the closest wins. 0 when none is.
 */
export const snapValues = (values: number[], targets: Box[], axis: Axis, reach: number): number => {
  let best = reach + 1;
  for (const value of values) {
    for (const target of targets) {
      for (const line of linesOf(target, axis)) {
        const gap = line - value;
        if (Math.abs(gap) < Math.abs(best)) best = gap;
      }
    }
  }
  return Math.abs(best) <= reach ? best : 0;
};

/** How far `box` must move along `axis` so its edge or centre sits on a line of `targets`. */
export const snapBox = (box: Box, targets: Box[], axis: Axis, reach: number) =>
  snapValues(linesOf(box, axis), targets, axis, reach);

export const overlaps = (a: Box, b: Box) =>
  a.x < b.x + b.width && b.x < a.x + a.width && a.y < b.y + b.height && b.y < a.y + a.height;

const contains = (outer: Box, inner: Box) =>
  outer.x <= inner.x &&
  outer.y <= inner.y &&
  outer.x + outer.width >= inner.x + inner.width &&
  outer.y + outer.height >= inner.y + inner.height;

/** Whether a box lies across the line at `at` on `axis`, between `from` and `to` along it. */
const crosses = (box: Box, axis: Axis, at: number, from: number, to: number) => {
  const across = ACROSS[axis];
  return box[axis] < at && at < box[axis] + box[SIZE[axis]] && box[across] < to && from < box[across] + box[SIZE[across]];
};

/**
 * The lines `box` sits on exactly, each drawn across every box that shares it, and per
 * line the space to the closest of those boxes, unless another box stands in between.
 */
export const guidesFor = (box: Box, targets: Box[]): Guides => {
  const lines = new Map<string, Guide>();
  const gaps = new Map<string, Guide>();
  for (const axis of ['x', 'y'] as const) {
    const across = ACROSS[axis];
    const size = SIZE[across];
    const own = linesOf(box, axis);
    for (const target of targets) {
      const start = Math.min(box[across], target[across]);
      const end = Math.max(box[across] + box[size], target[across] + target[size]);
      // The space between the two along the line; none when they overlap there.
      const before = box[across] - (target[across] + target[size]);
      const after = target[across] - (box[across] + box[size]);
      for (const at of linesOf(target, axis)) {
        if (!own.some((value) => Math.abs(value - at) < 0.01)) continue;
        const key = `${axis}${Math.round(at * 100)}`;
        const line = lines.get(key);
        lines.set(key, line ? { ...line, from: Math.min(line.from, start), to: Math.max(line.to, end) } : { axis, at, from: start, to: end });
        const gap = before > 0 ? { from: box[across] - before, to: box[across] } : after > 0 ? { from: box[across] + box[size], to: target[across] } : null;
        // A box between the two hides the gap; the frame around them doesn't.
        if (!gap || targets.some((other) => !contains(other, box) && crosses(other, axis, at, gap.from, gap.to))) continue;
        const closest = gaps.get(key);
        if (!closest || gap.to - gap.from < closest.to - closest.from) gaps.set(key, { axis, at, ...gap });
      }
    }
  }
  return { lines: [...lines.values()], gaps: [...gaps.values()] };
};

export type Alignment = 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';

/** Where `box` goes to line up with `bounds`. */
export const aligned = (box: Box, bounds: Box, alignment: Alignment): Point => {
  switch (alignment) {
    case 'left':
      return { x: bounds.x, y: box.y };
    case 'center':
      return { x: bounds.x + (bounds.width - box.width) / 2, y: box.y };
    case 'right':
      return { x: bounds.x + bounds.width - box.width, y: box.y };
    case 'top':
      return { x: box.x, y: bounds.y };
    case 'middle':
      return { x: box.x, y: bounds.y + (bounds.height - box.height) / 2 };
    case 'bottom':
      return { x: box.x, y: bounds.y + bounds.height - box.height };
  }
};

/**
 * New starts along `axis` that spread the boxes with equal space between them, in the order
 * they are given. The first and the last box stay where they are.
 */
export const distributed = (boxes: Box[], axis: Axis): number[] => {
  const size = SIZE[axis];
  const order = boxes.map((box, index) => ({ box, index })).sort((a, b) => a.box[axis] - b.box[axis]);
  const first = order[0]!.box;
  const last = order.reduce((end, { box }) => Math.max(end, box[axis] + box[size]), -Infinity);
  const filled = boxes.reduce((sum, box) => sum + box[size], 0);
  const space = (last - first[axis] - filled) / (boxes.length - 1);
  const starts: number[] = [];
  let next = first[axis];
  for (const { box, index } of order) {
    starts[index] = next;
    next += box[size] + space;
  }
  return starts;
};

};

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, nextTick, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem, useDnD, type FlatNode } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Icon from './Icon.vue';
import type { Layer } from './design';
import { EDITOR } from './editor';

const props = defineProps<{ node: FlatNode<Layer> }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ toggle: [] }>();
const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;
const { selection, status } = useDnD();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// Typed, so the canvas and its frames, which take layers and tools, refuse a row.
makeSortableItem(el, { id: () => props.node.key, type: 'row' });

const layer = computed(() => props.node.item);
// The selection is the canvas's: a row lights up with its layer, and faintly inside a
// selected frame, which its layers move with.
const selected = computed(() => selection.has(layer.value.id));
const inSelected = computed(() => {
  const frame = editor.parentOf(layer.value.id);
  return !selected.value && !!frame && selection.has(frame.id);
});

const pick = (event: MouseEvent) => editor.select(layer.value.id, event.shiftKey);
// Tabbing onto a row selects its layer; a click selects on its own (Shift adds).
const focus = () => {
  if (el.value?.matches(':focus-visible') && !selected.value && !layer.value.hidden) editor.select(layer.value.id);
};
// Hovering a row outlines its layer on the canvas.
const hover = (on: boolean) => {
  if (on && status.value === 'idle') editor.hovered.value = layer.value.id;
  else if (!on && editor.hovered.value === layer.value.id) editor.hovered.value = null;
};

// Double-click (or F2) renames. The field is an input: it never starts a drag.
const renaming = ref(false);
const field = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('field');
const rename = async () => {
  renaming.value = true;
  await nextTick();
  field.value?.select();
};
const finish = (save: boolean) => {
  if (!renaming.value) return;
  const name = field.value?.value.trim();
  renaming.value = false;
  if (save && name && name !== layer.value.name) editor.rename(layer.value, name);
};
</script>

    class="row"
    :class="{ selected, 'in-selected': inSelected, lit: editor.hovered.value === layer.id, 'is-hidden': layer.hidden }"
    :style="{ marginInlineStart: `${node.depth * 14}px` }"
    :aria-label="`${layer.name}${selected ? ', selected' : ''}`"
    :data-id="layer.id"
    @click="pick"
    @focus="focus"
    @dblclick="rename"
    @keydown.f2.prevent="rename"
    @pointerenter="hover(true)"
    @pointerleave="hover(false)"
  >
    <button
      v-if="layer.kind === 'frame'"
      type="button"
      class="chevron"
      :class="{ open: !node.collapsed }"
      :aria-label="`${node.collapsed ? 'Expand' : 'Collapse'} ${layer.name}`"
      :aria-expanded="!node.collapsed"
      @click.stop="emit('toggle')"
    >
      <Icon name="chevron" />
    </button>
    <span v-else class="indent" />
    <Icon :name="layer.kind" class="kind" />
    <input
      v-if="renaming"
      ref="field"
      class="rename"
      :value="layer.name"
      aria-label="Layer name"
      @keydown.enter.prevent="finish(true)"
      @keydown.esc.stop.prevent="finish(false)"
      @blur="finish(true)"
      @click.stop
      @dblclick.stop
    />
    <span v-else class="name">{{ layer.name }}</span>

import { computed, inject, nextTick, ref, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableTree, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import LayerRow from './LayerRow.vue';
import type { Layer } from './design';
import { EDITOR } from './editor';
import { overlaps } from './geometry';

const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;

// Rows have keys of their own: the layers' ids belong to their draggables on the canvas.
const rowKey = (layer: Layer) => `row:${layer.id}`;
const layerOf = (key: Key) => editor.find(String(key).slice('row:'.length)) ?? null;

const collapsed = ref(new Set<Key>());
const toggle = (key: Key) => (collapsed.value.has(key) ? collapsed.value.delete(key) : collapsed.value.add(key));

const tree = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('tree');
// The panel is the design itself, as a tree. Its order is the stacking order (the top row
// is in front), and a layer dropped onto a frame's row, or under it, moves into the frame.
const { items } = makeSortableTree(tree, {
  items: editor.layers,
  getKey: rowKey,
  // Frames take layers; frames themselves stay on the canvas.
  canNest: (layer, parent) => parent.kind === 'frame' && layer.kind !== 'frame',
  maxDepth: 1,
  indentation: 14,
  collapsed,
  // Changes made elsewhere (the canvas, undo) slide the rows too.
  animateChanges: true,
  autoScroll: true,
  onDrop: ({ items: moved, from, to }) => {
    if (from.parentKey === to.parentKey && from.index === to.index) return;
    editor.record();
    // A layer that changes frames stays where it is on the canvas: its position counts from
    // its frame's corner, so it takes the difference. Moved into a frame that doesn't cover
    // it, it would be clipped out of sight: it goes to the frame's middle instead. `onDrop`
    // runs before the tree is written, so `boxOf` still knows the frame it comes from.
    const frame = to.parentKey === null ? null : layerOf(to.parentKey);
    for (const layer of moved) {
      if (editor.parentOf(layer.id) === frame) continue;
      const box = editor.boxOf(layer);
      const into = frame ? editor.boxOf(frame) : { x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
      const middle = frame && !overlaps(box, into);
      layer.x = Math.round(middle ? (into.width - box.width) / 2 : box.x - into.x);
      layer.y = Math.round(middle ? (into.height - box.height) / 2 : box.y - into.y);
    }
  },
});

// A layer selected on the canvas may be out of sight here: its row scrolls into the panel
// (the panel only, not the page around the editor).
watch(
  () => editor.selected.value[0]?.id,
  async (id) => {
    await nextTick();
    const list = tree.value;
    const row = id ? list?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-id="${id}"]`) : null;
    if (!list || !row) return;
    if (row.offsetTop < list.scrollTop) list.scrollTop = row.offsetTop - 6;
    else if (row.offsetTop + row.offsetHeight > list.scrollTop + list.clientHeight) {
      list.scrollTop = row.offsetTop + row.offsetHeight - list.clientHeight + 6;
    }
  },
);

const count = computed(() => editor.layers.value.reduce((sum, layer) => sum + 1 + (layer.children?.length ?? 0), 0));
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';

// A number field as in design tools: type a value, step it with the arrow keys (Shift: by
// 10), or drag its label sideways to scrub it.
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ label: string; name: string; value: number; min?: number }>(), {
  min: -Infinity,
});
const emit = defineEmits<{ change: [value: number] }>();

/** What is typed, until Enter or leaving the field applies it. */
const draft = ref<string | null>(null);

const set = (value: number) => {
  const next = Math.max(props.min, Math.round(value));
  if (next !== props.value) emit('change', next);
};

const commit = () => {
  if (draft.value === null) return;
  const typed = draft.value.trim();
  draft.value = null;
  if (typed !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(typed))) set(Number(typed));
};

const step = (event: KeyboardEvent, direction: 1 | -1) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  draft.value = null;
  set(props.value + direction * (event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1));
};

const cancel = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  draft.value = null;
  (event.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
};

// Scrubbing: the label captures the pointer, and each pixel sideways is one unit.
const scrub = (event: PointerEvent) => {
  if (event.button !== 0) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const label = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
  label.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  const start = props.value;
  const move = (next: PointerEvent) => set(start + (next.clientX - event.clientX) * (next.shiftKey ? 10 : 1));
  const end = () => {
    label.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
    label.removeEventListener('pointerup', end);
    label.removeEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  };
  label.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
  label.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
  label.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="number">
    <span class="scrub" aria-hidden="true" :title="`Drag to change the ${name.toLowerCase()}`" @pointerdown="scrub">{{ label }}</span>
    <input
      :value="draft ?? value"
      inputmode="numeric"
      :aria-label="name"
      @focus="($event.target as HTMLInputElement).select()"
      @input="draft = ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value"
      @keydown.enter="commit"
      @keydown.up="step($event, 1)"
      @keydown.down="step($event, -1)"

import { computed, inject } from 'vue';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { EDITOR, SNAP } from './editor';
import { guidesFor, NO_GUIDES, snapValues, union, type Box } from './geometry';

const HANDLES = ['nw', 'n', 'ne', 'e', 'se', 's', 'sw', 'w'] as const;
type Handle = (typeof HANDLES)[number];

const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;
const { view, selected } = editor;
const { selection, status } = useDnD();

const toScreen = (box: Box) => ({
  left: `${view.x + box.x * view.zoom}px`,
  top: `${view.y + box.y * view.zoom}px`,
  width: `${box.width * view.zoom}px`,
  height: `${box.height * view.zoom}px`,
});

const boxes = computed(() => selected.value.map(editor.boxOf));
const bounds = computed(() => union(boxes.value));
const single = computed(() => (selected.value.length === 1 ? selected.value[0]! : null));
// While a drag runs, the clones in the overlay show where the layers are.
const shown = computed(() => bounds.value && status.value !== 'dragging' && status.value !== 'dropping');
// Hovered on the canvas or in the layers panel: an outline, unless it is selected anyway.
const hoverBox = computed(() => {
  const layer = editor.hovered.value ? editor.find(editor.hovered.value) : null;
  return layer && !selection.has(layer.id) && status.value === 'idle' ? editor.boxOf(layer) : null;
});

// ─── Resizing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Handles are plain pointer events: a resize changes a layer's box, it moves nothing anywhere.

let gestures = 0;

const resize = (handle: Handle, event: PointerEvent) => {
  const layer = single.value;
  if (!layer || event.button !== 0) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const grip = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
  grip.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  const start = editor.boxOf(layer);
  const frame = editor.parentOf(layer.id);
  const targets = editor.snapTargets([layer.id]);
  const origin = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
  // One undo step for the whole gesture.
  const key = `resize-${++gestures}`;

  const move = ({ clientX, clientY, shiftKey }: PointerEvent) => {
    const dx = (clientX - origin.x) / view.zoom;
    const dy = (clientY - origin.y) / view.zoom;
    // The edges the handle holds follow the pointer and snap to the other layers' lines.
    const snap = (value: number, axis: 'x' | 'y') =>
      shiftKey ? value : value + snapValues([value], targets, axis, SNAP / view.zoom);
    let left = start.x;
    let top = start.y;
    let right = start.x + start.width;
    let bottom = start.y + start.height;
    if (handle.includes('w')) left = Math.min(snap(left + dx, 'x'), right - 1);
    if (handle.includes('e')) right = Math.max(snap(right + dx, 'x'), left + 1);
    if (handle.includes('n')) top = Math.min(snap(top + dy, 'y'), bottom - 1);
    if (handle.includes('s')) bottom = Math.max(snap(bottom + dy, 'y'), top + 1);
    // A corner with Shift keeps the proportions, from the opposite corner.
    if (shiftKey && handle.length === 2) {
      const ratio = start.width / start.height;
      let width = right - left;
      let height = bottom - top;
      if (width / start.width > height / start.height) height = width / ratio;
      else width = height * ratio;
      if (handle.includes('w')) left = right - width;
      else right = left + width;
      if (handle.includes('n')) top = bottom - height;
      else bottom = top + height;
    }
    const box = { x: Math.round(left), y: Math.round(top), width: Math.round(right) - Math.round(left), height: Math.round(bottom) - Math.round(top) };
    editor.update(layer, { ...box, x: box.x - (frame?.x ?? 0), y: box.y - (frame?.y ?? 0) }, key);
    editor.guides.value = guidesFor(box, targets);
  };
  const end = () => {
    editor.guides.value = NO_GUIDES;
    grip.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
    grip.removeEventListener('pointerup', end);
    grip.removeEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  };
  grip.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
  grip.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
  grip.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
};
</script>

import { inject } from 'vue';
import type { DnDEvent } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import type { Layer, LayerKind } from './design';
import { EDITOR } from './editor';

/** What a tool of the toolbar carries while it is dragged: the kind of layer it adds. */
export interface ToolData {
  tool: LayerKind;
  zoom: number;
}

/**
 * The canvas and every frame take drops alike. `position` is where the grabbed layer's
 * corner was let go inside the target, in screen pixels: turned into world units, it says
 * how far that layer went, and every dragged layer moves as far, into the frame (or onto
 * the canvas). Alt held leaves them in place and drops copies. A tool from the toolbar
 * adds its layer centred on the drop point.
 */
export function useLayerDrop(frame: () => Layer | null) {
  const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;

  return ({ active, over, pointer, position }: DnDEvent) => {
    const target = frame();
    const { view } = editor;
    // The target's corner in the world: the frame's, or whatever the canvas shows at its corner.
    const corner = target ? editor.boxOf(target) : { x: -view.x / view.zoom, y: -view.y / view.zoom };
    const toWorld = (x: number, y: number) => ({ x: corner.x + x / view.zoom, y: corner.y + y / view.zoom });

    const { tool } = active.data as Partial<ToolData>;
    if (tool && over) return editor.add(tool, toWorld(pointer.x - over.rect.left, pointer.y - over.rect.top), target);

    const grabbed = editor.find(active.id);
    if (!grabbed || !position) return;
    const from = editor.boxOf(grabbed);
    const to = toWorld(position.x, position.y);
    editor.move(active.ids, { x: to.x - from.x, y: to.y - from.y }, target, editor.altHeld.value);
  };
}
